Phase 1 of the session (reading the roadmap, the register, RADIO_DATA_GATE.md, the checkpoint, the galactic, statistics, radiation and spectrograph kernels) preceded it and fixed nothing here from a result. No expected value below is the output of the kernel: every one is either arithmetic written in the leg or a bound set by the stated discretisation.
rule: A crossed bound is a failed check, recorded in failed-legs.json and left failing; only Carl resets one. A leg that cannot be measured (a file not supplied) is NOT RUN and says why. No published number or licence term is typed anywhere from memory except the two atomic constants of the 21-cm line (the rest frequency and the spin-flip rate), which are physical constants, are held in ONE module with their status 'no source file in the tree, not verified by a fetch', and are a question for Carl; nothing here is quoted from a survey, a table or a paper. Every velocity the kernel returns carries the frame (heliocentric or LSR), the Doppler convention and the LSR option it was computed with. A tangent velocity is never shown without the assumed R0 and Theta0 and the LSR choice. The tangent-point method is only ever run on the fixed longitude mask below.

seeds.design: hi-241-design (used only to calibrate the one shape term and to debug; never in a leg)

scope.built: (1) the 21-cm rest frequency and the radio, optical and relativistic Doppler conventions on a frequency axis; (2) the heliocentric to LSR velocity transform with the two options of D-GAIA-03 kept (Schonrich, Binney and Dehnen 2010's (U, V, W) and the same with V replaced by the Stromberg value of the register row), a caller-supplied (U, V, W), and 'none', each returned with the shift it applied; (3) the fixed longitude mask, the geometry of line-of-sight velocity under an axisymmetric circular rotation curve, the tangent point and its refusals; (4) the terminal-velocity rule (edge rule E below) with the dispersion correction computed from the universal shape of a Gaussian-smoothed tangent edge; (5) the circular speed at the tangent radius with a 68.27 and 95 percent interval from the statistics kernel's covariance interval; (6) the column density from the integrated line under the optically thin assumption with an opacity diagnostic and the regime where the assumption fails; (7) a synthetic HI spectrum generator (a stated rotation curve, a gas disk of constant density between two radii, Gaussian gas dispersion, an optional spin temperature that makes the radiative transfer exact, white noise from a named stream) with a truth manifest and a label.
scope.notBuilt: the spectra viewer's radio mode, the sightline selector, the tangent-point tool and the 150 record, both investigations, the model-page section and instructor materials (a separate instructional PR after Carl's go-ahead); any pack (packs have 0 B of room and every HI row of the data-rights gate is C: the synthetic generator is the pack and it is code); any fit outside the mask; non-circular motions, a warp, a bar, gas outside the plane (b is 0 on the mask); self-absorption beyond the opacity diagnostic; correlated noise; stray radiation and baselines.

synthetic.label: SYNTHETIC HI SPECTRA: invented worlds with a stated rotation curve and gas disk, not measurements of the Galaxy. R0, Theta0 and every curve parameter below are the world's truth, chosen round, and no published value.
synthetic.curve: Theta(R) = Theta0 k (R / sqrt(R^2 + Rc^2)) (R / R0)^alpha with k = sqrt(R0^2 + Rc^2) / R0, so Theta(R0) = Theta0

gas.note: constant n between R_in and R_out, zero outside

channels.axis: uniform in frequency about the rest frequency, so uniform in radio velocity to first order and not exactly

opacity.note: the opacity diagnostic reports the thin assumption as failed when the peak optical depth tau = -ln(1 - T_peak / T_s) exceeds this limit

mask.why: inside 20 degrees the tangent radius is under 0.35 R0 and an axisymmetric circular model is not claimed there; past 65 degrees the terminal velocity falls toward the dispersion of the local gas and the edge cannot be separated from it (the kernel also refuses by measurement, rule E7)

edgeRule.name: edge rule E (stated, committed)
steps: E1 the terminal side: x = s v_LSR with s = +1 in the first quadrant and -1 in the fourth, channels sorted by x
E2 the noise: sigma_n from the caller, else 1.4826 times the median absolute deviation about the median of the outermost tenth of the channels in x
E3 the outer edge of emission x_out: the largest x that ends a run of at least 3 consecutive channels all at or above L_out = max(5 sigma_n, 1e-3 times the largest T on the side)
E4 the window [x_out - 5 sigma_v, x_out]; T_pk is the largest T in it, at x_pk; refused ('edge-not-significant') if T_pk is below 10 sigma_n
E5 x_e: the outermost crossing of T = f T_pk beyond x_pk, by linear interpolation, with f = 0.5

E6 the terminal velocity x_t = x_e - c_f sigma_v, where c_f (in units of sigma_v) is the distance between the true edge of an inverse-square-root tangent profile smoothed by a Gaussian and the point where that smoothed profile falls to f of its own peak; it is computed by quadrature in the kernel, not tuned
E7 refused ('edge-not-separable') if x_t is below 3 sigma_v

uncertainty.formula: sigma_Theta^2 = sigma_x^2 + (w / sqrt(12))^2 + (c_f sigma_sigmaV)^2 + (tau sigma_v)^2 + (sin(l) sigma_Theta0)^2; sigma_x = sigma_n sqrt(1 + f^2) / |slope| with slope the least-squares dT/dx over the five channels about the crossing; w the channel width in velocity; sigma_sigmaV the stated uncertainty of the assumed gas dispersion; tau the shape term. The interval is the statistics kernel's covarianceInterval at 0.6827 and 0.95.
uncertainty.tauNote: PROVISIONAL. The shape term is the one number of this file that is calibrated: it stands for the departure of a real edge from the pure inverse-square-root form. It is set once from the design ensemble (seed hi-241-design, never a test seed) and recorded as amendment AM1 before any test-seed run; until then 0.25 is the written value.

checks.what: the Doppler scale: a frequency below the rest frequency is a positive velocity (receding); v = 0 at the rest frequency; the radio-convention velocity v = c (1 - f / f0) round-trips through the frequency to within a relative 1e-12 at 50 velocities between -300 and 300 km/s; the optical-convention velocity minus the radio-convention velocity at the same frequency is v_r^2 / (c - v_r) to 1e-9 km/s; the relativistic velocity v = c (f0^2 - f^2) / (f0^2 + f^2) lies between the radio and optical values at 300 km/s; the three conventions differ by under 0.5 km/s at 5 km/s

the LSR transform v_LSR = v_helio + (U cos l + V sin l) cos b + W sin b: the shift is U at (l, b) = (0, 0), V at (90, 0), W at (0, 90); it is zero at the longitude l = atan2(-U, V) for b = 0; the transform and its inverse compose to the identity to 1e-12 km/s; the option 'schonrich' equals (11.1, 12.24, 7.25) and the option 'stromberg' has V = 3.77 with the same U and W (D-GAIA-03); 'none' shifts nothing; each result names the option and the shift; an unknown option is refused

the line-of-sight velocity v = (Theta(R) R0 / R - Theta0) sin l cos b with R^2 = R0^2 + (d cos b)^2 - 2 R0 d cos b cos l: for a flat curve Theta = Theta0 the terminal velocity is Theta0 (1 - |sin l|), the tangent radius R0 |sin l| and the tangent distance R0 cos l; for each of the three world curves at the mask's longitudes the maximum of v along the sightline, found by golden-section search to 1e-9 kpc, equals the tangent value to 1e-9 km/s and lies at d = R0 cos l to 1e-6 kpc; the circular speed recovered from the terminal velocity, |v_t| + Theta0 |sin l|, equals Theta(R_t) to 1e-9 km/s; the suitability test (Theta / R decreasing over the mask's radii) passes for the three world curves and fails for solid-body rotation Theta = 10 R

the tangent point and the mask refuse by code: longitudes 90, 95, 100, 135, 180, 225, 265 and 270 have no tangent point ('no-tangent-point': the sightline does not pass inside the solar circle); longitudes 0, 10, 15, 22, 70, 75, 80, 285, 345 and 355 are outside the fixed mask ('outside-mask') although some have a tangent point; a latitude other than 0 is 'outside-mask'; every longitude of the mask is accepted; the mask has 10 + 10 longitudes and equals the list in this file

the column density of an optically thin line: for the noise-free thin spectrum of world flat:5 at l = 30 the thin column from the integrated line (the kernel's coefficient times the trapezoid integral of T over velocity) equals the generator's own column (the integral of n along the sightline, in cm^-2) to a relative 2e-4; doubling n doubles the column; the integral is independent of the channel width to 2e-4 (a spectrum regridded to 2 channels per original channel is not tested here; the channel-width test is the 5001-channel narrow world against the 501-channel one at the same sigma_v)

the universal edge profile g(x) = 2 integral_0^inf phi(x + t^2) dt (phi the standard normal density; the inverse-square-root edge smoothed by a unit Gaussian, x measured outward from the true edge): g(0) = 2^(-3/4) Gamma(1/4) / sqrt(2 pi) to a relative 1e-8, with Gamma from the statistics kernel's lnGamma; g is positive, has one maximum at x_pk below 0, falls beyond it, and c_f(f) is increasing in 1 - f; c_f(0.5) lies between 0 and 1.5 and the profile at c_f(0.5) is half of the peak to 1e-9

the tangent velocity is recovered on noise-free narrow-line spectra: gas dispersion 0.5 km/s, 5001 channels of 0.1 km/s, the three world curves at longitudes 20, 35, 50, 65, 295, 320 and 340, the correct R0, Theta0, LSR option and gas dispersion: the recovered circular speed differs from the world's Theta(R_t) by at most 0.3 km/s, and no sightline is refused

the LSR choice moves the recovered circular speed by an exact amount: between options o1 and o2 the circular speed at a first-quadrant longitude changes by (U2 - U1) cos l + (V2 - V1) sin l and at a fourth-quadrant longitude by -(U2 - U1) cos l + (V2 - V1) |sin l| (so a change of V looks like a change of Theta0 and a change of U is an asymmetry between the quadrants); checked on the same noisy spectrum of world flat:8 at every mask longitude between 'schonrich' and 'stromberg' to 1e-9 km/s

the Doppler conversions against astropy.units' doppler_radio, doppler_optical and doppler_relativistic equivalencies with the same rest frequency, on 200 frequencies between -500 and 500 km/s (seed oracleNumpy 241), the kernel's velocity from frequency and its frequency from velocity in all three conventions.
